shows.name: The Curious & Creative Podcast
shows.tagline: Where creative strategy meets real conversation.
shows.about: A deep dive into the minds of artists, creators, and innovators — the ideas, decisions, and cultural moments that shape how we see (and sell) the world.

shows.name: The Eclectic Polymath
shows.tagline: Everything is interesting when you dig deep enough.
shows.about: Deep, well-researched episodes on whatever's too interesting to ignore: history and power, religion and myth, psychology, science, and Black culture. No lane, no niche.

shows.name: Too Much to Tweet
shows.tagline: The takes too big for a caption.
shows.about: Politics, culture, and the conversations the internet keeps trying to flatten into a thread.

shows.name: Approachable AI
shows.tagline: Demystifying AI, one episode at a time.
shows.about: No jargon, just what's actually happening and why it matters. Real tools, real builds, and the mistakes along the way.
shows.description: Welcome to Approachable AI: Your shortcut to understanding artificial intelligence in plain English. We explore what’s happening, why it matters, and how you can use it so that AI feels less like the future and more like a part of your everyday routine.

shows.name: Aspiring Abolitionist
shows.tagline: Politics, policy, and culture from an abolitionist lens.
shows.about: The political, social, and cultural moments shaping our world — from HUD policy to the 2025 Inauguration.
shows.description: Welcome to Aspiring Abolitionist, the podcast where we dive into the political, social, and cultural moments shaping our world today.

shows.name: Dominate the Decade
shows.tagline: Growth, culture, and building a meaningful decade.
shows.about: Three young Black men navigating their own paths to success — crypto, politics, sports, music, movies, and everything in between. The full 2020–2023 run, including Janel's guest episode.
shows.description: Three black young men, each navigating their individual paths to success. Follow along and join in as we strive to dominate the decade in all aspects of life.

#005 How I Built "The Eclectic Polymath Podcast"
episodes.description:
Welcome back to Approachable AI, where I explore practical ways to use AI, test new tools, build real projects, and make emerging technology easier to understand.
In this episode, I’m taking you behind the scenes of how I built "The Eclectic Polymath Podcast" using AI. Instead of focusing on one specific deep-dive topic, I’m walking through the full methodology behind the show: how a random curiosity becomes a research question, how I use multiple AI tools to expand and organize the idea, and how that research eventually becomes a complete long-form audio episode.
Key topics covered:
• Turning personal curiosity into a repeatable content system
• Using AI for deep research and narrative…

episodes.title: Episode #004: Vibe Coding My 2026 AI Resolution Challenge
episodes.description:
Welcome to 2026! I'm back with a raw, unfiltered look at building AI-powered apps in real-time.
In this episode, I'm kicking off a 10-week AI resolution challenge inspired by the AI Daily Brief podcast. Watch me build a complete resolution tracker app using Google AI Studio, complete with project management features, voice dictation, and custom milestones.
Key topics covered:
• Building a resolution tracker with Google AI Studio
• 10-week AI upskilling challenge breakdown
• Live coding and iterative app development
• Google-Apple AI partnership news breakdown
• Why voice-first development is the future
• Real-time problem-solving and debugging
This isn't your typical polished tutorial -…

episodes.title: Episode #003: Building An AI Bias Radar By Training It To Read Between the Lines
episodes.description:
In this episode of Approachable AI, Joshua brings you into a live build session of what we're calling "Veritas", a bias rating app for news, podcasts, and other media. Drawing on his journalism background, he breaks down why “unbiased” news doesn’t really exist, what different kinds of bias look like in language, and how AI can help surface those patterns in a more transparent way. Then he vibe codes Veritas in real time, tweaking prompts, wiring up UIs, and stress testing the tool on live articles from across the political spectrum.
You’ll see him refine the scoring system for opinion density, emotional language, framing, and certainty, build a bias index of outlets like Reuters, NPR, Fox,…

episodes.title: Episode #002: Live Vibe Coding: Mastering Tools And Building Your Own
episodes.description:
Welcome back to Approachable AI, your shortcut to understanding artificial intelligence in plain English. We explore what’s happening, why it matters, and how you can use AI so that it feels less like the future and more like a part of your everyday routine.
In Episode #002, recorded on November 21, 2025, we react to a massive week in AI history: the game-changing launch of Google Gemini 3.0. In this episode, we dive deep into the concept of "vibe coding"—using advanced models to build applications without having any technical background or knowledge of computer science languages like Python. We explore the differences between the standard Google Gemini interface and the more robust…

episodes.title: Episode #001: Trying, Failing, And Trying Again With ChatGPT Atlas, Google Gemini & Google AI Studio
episodes.description:
Welcome to the premiere of Approachable AI, your shortcut to understanding artificial intelligence in plain English. We explore what’s happening, why it matters, and how you can use it so that AI feels less like the future and more like a part of your everyday workflow.
In this episode, we dive straight into the messy, creative reality of using today’s most powerful tools. We aren't just talking about concepts; we are live-testing them. Watch as we navigate the highs and lows of rapid prototyping—bouncing between ChatGPT Atlas, Google Gemini, and Google AI Studio to see what happens when you push these models to their limits. It’s a look at the "trial and error" process required to turn raw…

episodes.title: Day One: Trump’s Return, Executive Orders, and Global Shifts
episodes.description:
It’s Inauguration Day 2025, and Donald Trump is back in the Oval Office. 
 From 42 executive orders—including pardons, policy reversals, and global declarations—to claims about reshaping America’s role on the world stage, we break down the first day of this new presidency. 
 Join us as we explore what these moves mean for the U.S. and beyond.

episodes.title: A New Dimension: Exploring Crypto, NFTs and the Metaverse (Feat. Ryck Digital)
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast! 
In this week's episode, Josh sits down with a special guest, Ryck Digital, a crypto and overall web3 enthusiast. Together, they discuss the ever-evolving world of cryptocurrency, NFTs, and the Metaverse.
Topics include:
 The basics of Blockchain technology and its potential impact on various industries. 
 The world of NFTs, their significance, and potential as a new medium for artists and creators.
 The Metaverse and it's ability to serve as a new economic platform for social interactions
 The importance of minorities staying up-to-date with developments in the crypto and web3 space 
 Ways that people looking to get into…

episodes.title: NBA Madness & A Super Bowl Spectacle
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
In this week's episode, Matt and Josh dive into the latest NBA news, as the trade deadline has just passed. They discuss some of the biggest moves, including Kevin Durant heading to the Suns and Kyrie Irving joining Luka Doncic on the Mavericks. They also touch on some other key storylines, such as LeBron James passing Kareem Abdul-Jabbar as the all-time leading scorer in NBA history.
In addition to the NBA, Matt and Josh also break down the most recent Super Bowl, which featured an amazing game between the Chiefs and the Eagles, as well as a halftime show from none other than Rihanna. They discuss the game's highlights,…

episodes.title: Year in Review: 2/10
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade podcast; The last of 2021!
This week, the guys do an end of the year catch up to reflect on how they felt about 2021 and what they're looking forward to in 2022. From *spoiler-free* reviews of Spider-Man: No Way Home, to predictions on if there will be a post-pandemic renaissance to the likes of the Harlem renaissance that came off the heels of the Spanish Flu of 1918.
Check out the episode and for even more content, you can find Dominate the Decade on social media; Instagram: @dominatethedecade, Twitter: @dominate_decade, and Facebook: Dominate the Decade.
As always, thank you for your support of the podcast. Let’s all continue to…

episodes.title: Let's Talk about Education with Johnetta Moore, Brandon Reeder, and Qhira Bonds
episodes.description: Join us as we dive deep into education during the pandemic, ways to move forward, and tips for current and incoming teachers!

episodes.title: Let's Talk about ADHD with Kami Ufford
episodes.description: This episode we will be discussing ADHD and how it effects our lives. This is the first of the new style of episode for Aspiring Abolitionist. I plan to delve deeper into the people that stand behind and create the policies I analyzed in earlier episodes. Make sure to subscribe and follow the podcast on Anchor, Apple Music, and Spotify.

episodes.title: The Boys Are Back!
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode and another SEASON of the Dominate the Decade Podcast! 
 The guys are back after an extended break following season one and per usual, the world is already much different from the last time we touched the mics. It has officially been one year (!!!) since the first official lockdowns that began due to COVID-19 outbreaks. This week, we get into the rapidly approaching reopening of the world as measures are (seemingly) being put into place in order to return to normal.  
 Topics include:  
 How much our lives have changed in the last year  
 Black History Month 2021 Stimulus checks hitting - and not hitting - accounts  
 Recent moves in financial markets   
…

episodes.title: Capitol Offense
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
 The guys take a break from taking a break to discuss the storming of the U.S. Capitol building as well as the victories of Senators-Elect Rev. Raphael Warnock and Jon Ossoff of Georgia. We also discuss President Trump’s ban from several social media platforms. 
 Be sure to tune in and let us know your thoughts on what’s been going on around us! And whatever else you choose to do, dominate it. 
 For even more content, you can check out Dominate the Decade on social media; Instagram: @dominatethedecade, Twitter: @dominate_decade, and Facebook: Dominate the Decade.
 As always, thank you for your support of the podcast. Let’s…

episodes.title: Year in Review: 1/10
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
 The guys are back after a longer than expected hiatus and this week, we're wrapping up season one of the podcast by saying goodbye to 2020! 
 Despite the unexpected nature of the year derailed by Covid-19, there are so many things worth looking back on over the past 12 months. We do just that and recount on the moments that made (and broke) 2020!
 Topics include: 
 Our favorite episodes of the inaugural season of Dominate the Decade 
 How much has changed since the beginning of the year 
 How we fared with our goals for the past year and what we need to change for the coming year 
 Things to look forward to in 2021 and…

episodes.title: Post-Election
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
 Following last week's pre-election conversation, this week, we check in and discuss the results of the long -awaited election that resulted in Joe Biden being predicted to be the 46th President of the United States.
 Topics include: Main takeaways from the election, the first woman Vice President being a Black woman, what we are looking forward to seeing change over the next four years, the potential stock market implications and much more! 
 Check out the episode and let us know your thoughts! 
 For even more content, you can check out Dominate the Decade on social media; Instagram: @dominatethedecade, Twitter:…

episodes.title: Pre-Election
episodes.description:
We're back with another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
In this week's episode, with it already being November (???), we reflect back on the crazy ride that this year has been to date while also taking in how much more there is left to unfold before 2020 goes down in the books. 
We discuss the impending election that is ONE day away along with the candidates' respective plans for the black community, how we can hold elected officials accountable regardless of the outcome, Diddy and the potential of a black political party, what's going on with Ice Cube and 50 cent, Killer Mike launching Greenwood Bank and more!
Check out the episode and let us know your thoughts! For even more…

episodes.title: Censorship in Music
episodes.description: Listen in as I detail how censorship in music limits freedom of expression and free speech. I will work through a variety of examples mostly pulling from current examples like YNW Melly and Tay K. The end of the episode features an interview from the Today Show where Ice Cube details his time in NWA and his thoughts on censorship. Happy listening :)

episodes.title: Resources To Dominate The Decade
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
 This week we decided to do something a little different; Instead of coming with some hot topics, we're coming at you with some great resources that have the potential to change your life! 
 Whether it be free audiobooks from Libby, daily motivational quotes from the Quote of The Day Show or budgeting made easy with EveryDollar, the tools that we talk about in this episode are ones that have changed our individual lives for the better!
 Check out the discussion and let us know of any additional resources that help make make you a better you. For even more content, you can check out Dominate the Decade on social media;…

episodes.title: And The Plot Thickens...
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
 We took a week off but are back with another wide ranging-conversation, this time with even more ambiguity in the world than when we left off two weeks ago. 
 In the episode, we check in with each other and talk about how life is treating us individually, the first Presidential debate and all that went down before, during and after it, recent developments of Trump contracting Covid-19 and the potential chess move that this may be from his campaign, and much more!
 We also spend time breaking down the classic movie, Menace 2 Society. We take a deep dive into the plot and some of the latent messages of the film.
 Check out…

episodes.title: Let's Talk About Weed
episodes.description: I'm back and better! This is the first episode of Season 2 and we have to start with a bang. Listen as I go through a brief history of cannabis in America and speak with Adesuwa Joseph -- an entrepreneur in Charlotte who's business centers around cannabis. Happy Listening :)

episodes.title: Let's Talk About Green Book
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another week of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
 In this week's episode, the guys get together and discuss the 2019 Academy Award Best Picture winner, Green Book. We break down the intricacies of the plot, the historical accuracy and context of the film, the "White Savior" narrative in the movie as well as others of the same theme, and much more!
 We also throw praise on 22 year old tennis phenom, Naomi Osaka, who recently won her second U.S. Open title. Along with her dominance on the tennis court, she has also surpassed Serena Williams as the highest paid female athlete in the world. We discuss the importance of this as well as her vocality about social justice issues.
…

episodes.title: Millz Davis, Kanye West & Nick Cannon
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
This week, we bring on music artist, entrepreneur, and a future tycoon himself, Millz Davis.
In this episode, we chop it up with Millz about his recent projects, what goes into making an album, getting into the creative process, inspirations for his style of music, being an independent artist and everything that comes with it, ownership, the inner-workings of the music industry and what actually goes on behind the scenes, the traps that artists fall into with contracts and much more!
We also discussed the recently released two-part Cannon’s Class interview with Kanye West and Nick Cannon. Way too many topics in this one to…

episodes.title: Message To My Younger Self (feat. David Daniels)
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
 This week, we're back with another great conversation, this time featuring David Daniels who is an engineer, real estate investor, project manager, husband, father... and Josh's Uncle!
 Topics in this episode include: How to get started as a young adult in Real Estate, tips for saving, investing and budgeting, how to form your exit strategy for retirement, relationship advice for both men and women, doing business and building an empire with your significant other and MUCH more!
 If you’re liking the podcast, don’t forget to share with a friend and let them know you want them to #DominateTheDecade as well! If you have any…

episodes.title: AA Birthday Edition
episodes.description: Listen in as I discuss my favorite piece of legislation -- can you guess what it is?

episodes.title: Road to Glory (feat. Khris Pam)
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade podcast! On this week's episode, the guys bring in Newberry College defensive back and former Blythewood Bengal, Khris Pam. 
We discuss his path to where he is today, which includes dominance on the gridiron, his time with the Gamecocks, setbacks with injuries, a stop in JuCo at Georgia Military Academy and what he is ultimately aiming for in the future. 
Topics include: The difference between JuCo and Universities, life as a student-athlete at a military school, Last Chance U and how accurate the show is, the character building and brotherhood that playing football and being in the military brings, how players are responding to…

episodes.title: No Limit Chronicles
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade podcast! 
 We took last week off but we are back this week with another packed conversation, this time centering around Percy Miller aka "Master P" and the 5-part BET documentary about his life and rise to mogul status: No Limit Chronicles.
 Topics on this episode include Master P's upbringing, starting the No Limit record label, the Romeo Show, owning your own products, entrepreneur mindset, film production, vertical integration, his basketball and NBA career, J Cole's eye on the NBA and much more! 
 Outside of Master P and the No Limit Chronicles, the guys also discuss the virtual graduation ceremony that (finally) took place,…

episodes.title: The RICO
episodes.description: Listen in as I talk about the statute that ties organized crime, street gangs and drug cartels together. Infamously tagged as the RICO, this statute introduces a way to tie racketeering activity to who engages in the activity and who orders it! This was a great topic to explore and way for me to decide what I believe safety truly is -- I encourage you all to evaluate the idea of community safety and what that would look like for ALL the members of your community.

episodes.title: Keep Portland White
episodes.description: Listen in as I delve into what the heck is going on in Portland. Too often, we displace racism as a uniquely Southern issue while racism is all around us -- Portland is a glaring example of that. Happy Listening!

episodes.title: THE Aspiring Abolitionist (feat. Janel Moore)
episodes.description:
On this week’s episode, the guys sit down with THE aspiring abolitionist herself, Janel Moore.
 A native of Macon, Georgia, Janel is a rising senior at the University of South Carolina, majoring in global studies. She is the host of the Aspiring Abolitionist Podcast which focuses on politics and policies on both the local and national level.
 In this episode, we discuss how Janel got into politics at a young age, pivotal moments that shaped her interests, starting a podcast, the importance of local elections,  the role of media in politics, being a black woman in America and much more!
 You can find the Aspiring Abolitionist podcast on all streaming platforms as well as on Instagram…

episodes.title: HUD is a dud
episodes.description:
Listen in as I highlight the rollback of the 2012 Equal Access Rule of the Office of Housing and Urban Development. Ben Carson leads HUD -- with his expertise residing from a childhood in low income housing. Secretary Carson made headlines when he announced plans to rollback the 2016 guidance administered during the Obama Administration. 
 Also, I got the opportunity to speak with the boys from Dominate the Decade - another great podcast out on all streaming platforms! Check out their podcast and social media pages @dominate_decade on Twitter and @dominatethedecade on Instagram! Happy listening!

episodes.title: Good Trouble & Golden Wings
episodes.description:
On this week’s episode, the guys venture out to Irmo, South Carolina to chop it up with the owners of Golden Wings, Jason and James. Along with their backgrounds, the two co-owners give game on how to start a business, what it really takes to open up a restaurant, big city culture vs small town vibes, building a black-owned economy, speaking life into their children, entrepreneurship being passed down in the family, the freedom of being your own boss, your network being an asset and more!
 In addition, we also recognize the life and legacy of civil rights leader, advocate, and politician, John Robert Lewis as well as minister and civil rights leader, C.T. Vivian.
 Check out the guys over at…

episodes.title: The Limitations of the Melting Pot
episodes.description: This week, I am reflecting on our asylum systems in the United States. Listen in as I dissect the Refugee Act of 1980 and the current status of asylum in the United States.

episodes.title: A Kid From Coney Island
episodes.description:
We're back with another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast! 
 On this week's episode, the guys sit down and discuss the recently released Netflix documentary "A Kid From Coney Island" detailing the life of former NBA player and CBA legend, Stephon Marbury. His story is an inspiring one of expectations, stardom, pressure, depression, reinvention, self-mastery and perseverance.
 We also introduce Matt's class and discuss the NFL, the history of the Black Quarterback in the sport and fast-forward to a time that has been deemed, "The Year of the Black QB". 
 We end the episode with a quiz on things that can get your black card revoked and much more! Check out the episode and leave your…

episodes.title: The Heritage Act
episodes.description: Listen in as I explain why people are calling for the removal of confederate monuments across the United States. This fight is not new. I analyze the Heritage Act, the role of confederate monuments in preserving revisionist history, and an interview with Repeal the Heritage Act's Jazmyne McCrae and Helen Knight. Happy listening!

episodes.title: Man of the Streets vs. Man of the People
episodes.description:
We are back with another episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast!
In this episode, Josh, Matt and Adarius discuss the plethora of current events surrounding the "holiday" weekend. From Kanye announcing that he is running for president and the potential impact of this announcement, to the troubles of the two-party system in America and ways it has failed us in the past; this wide-ranging episode is packed with many topics and just as many hot takes. 
The guys also break down the highly-acclaimed book detailing the life and legacy of the great El-Hajj Malik El-Shabazz: The Autobiography of Malcom X.
Stay up to date with all things Dominate the Decade on social media, find us on Twitter:…

episodes.title: Liberty and Justice (?) for All
episodes.description: This episode involves an analysis of the two policy proposals: JUSTICE Act and the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act. Is justice being served to the many victims of police brutality? Listen now!

episodes.title: Land of the Free?
episodes.description: Adarius, Matt and Josh get together and discuss the Netflix documentary “13th” as well as the film “Just Mercy” which both raise the question... is America really the land of the free?

episodes.title: 8 Minutes & 46 Seconds
episodes.description: This first episode will first introduce the podcast host, Janel Moore. Janel will outline her inspirations and early indicators for her love fo ropily. She will also honor and acknowledge victims of police brutality, race and anti-LGBTQ+ violence.

episodes.title: Seven7h Ward's Finest (feat. Malik Brazile)
episodes.description:
This week on the Dominate the Decade Podcast, the guys sit down with Malik Brazile ( @ayeitsleek ) and chop it up about longevity in the YouTube game, entrepreneurship and his clothing brand, Seven7h ( @seven7h_co ), making the leap into acting and much more! 
 Check out the Seven7h luxury streetwear clothing brand at https://seven7hco.com/ 
 Make sure to like, rate, subscribe, and leave any feedback for the podcast! Links to all things Dominate the Decade at https://linktr.ee/DominateTheDecade

episodes.title: Crash Course
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the Dominate the Decade podcast! 
 In this episode, Adarius, Josh, and Matt come together to talk about the 2005 film "Crash" and it's relevance to the present, Killer Mike, his views on the culture and where we can go from here, Melissa Chen on the difference between the American Dream and the long term goals of China, the NFL's "statement" on #BLM, Dabo Swinney, and much more.
 For updates and bonus content, follow the podcast on Instagram @dominatethedecade and Twitter @dominate_decade.

episodes.title: The Intro
episodes.description:
Welcome to the inaugural episode of the Dominate the Decade Podcast! Hosted by Adarius Simpkins, Matthew Anderson, and Josh German, the guys come together to discuss topics pertaining to their lives, the community, and the culture.
In this episode, the topics include:
Protests surrounding the injustices involving George Floyd, Breanna Taylor, and Ahmaud Arbery
Dr. Umar Johnson and his school for black youth
Byron Allen, his story, and building a media empire
Follow the Dominate The Decade Podcast on social media:
Instagram: @dominatethedecade
Twitter: @dominate_decade
